caption: Admins get system access by default; everyone else needs the same USE CATALOG / USE SCHEMA / SELECT grants as any catalog.

code:
SELECT billing_origin_product,
       SUM(usage_quantity) AS total_dbus
FROM system.billing.usage
WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30)
GROUP BY billing_origin_product
ORDER BY total_dbus DESC;
caption: 30 days of usage by product — including DATA_CLASSIFICATION and JOBS — straight from the same catalog as the audit trail.
